generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: an introduced biennial thistle: a tall, branched, spiny stem with deeply lobed, spine-tipped leaves and large magenta flower heads on spiny green balls. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 1.2 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: dark grey-green leaves; magenta heads.

appearance.organs.flower.note: The head's look, the model's choice where the flora gives no number: about 130 phyllaries in its 10 to 12 rows; the florets standing 0.6 of the disc's radius out of the involucre, as the purple brush does in photographs; the head's colour the green of its involucre, its accent the florets' purple.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.note: FNA's account of the species (Keil, volume 19), as search results quote copies of its text (the pages themselves were not read): involucres hemispheric to bell-shaped, 3 to 4 cm tall and 2 to 4 cm across; phyllaries in 10 to 12 rows, overlapping, the outer and middle ones tipped with spines 2 to 5 mm long.

traits.pappus_length_m.note: VicFlora's account of the species, as quoted in search results (the page itself was not read): corollas 25 to 35 mm long, purple; pappus 2 to 2.5 cm long.

sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy from the step-6 catalogue, authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands. Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
